expectations.evidence: Names process narration (quotes Phase 1/2/3 text), overclaim (quotes 'definitely the root cause'), arrow chain (quotes A -> ... -> B), checkmark overclaim (quotes '✅ Production is fixed and ready'), trailing recap (quotes 'In summary...') — at least three applicable anti-patterns with quoted draft text.
Rewrite opens with 'Checkout is back to normal: disabling... at 16:42 UTC... by 16:47 UTC' then 'The root cause isn't confirmed yet' — recovery first, then unproven status, before any process detail.
Uses 'The root cause isn't confirmed yet' and 'The strongest lead is a cache key'; never repeats 'definitely' or asserts the cache as proven root cause.
States 'based on 7 of the 312 failed requests we traced; other failure mechanisms haven't been ruled out' — preserves both the 7/312 sample and open possibility of other mechanisms.
Notes flag disabled at 16:42 / baseline 16:47 and explicitly preserves rollback avoidance reason: 'v4.8 ... also carries a security patch that disabling the flag didn't touch'.
States 'All 418 existing unit tests and 6 new regression tests ... pass, but the full integration suite hasn't run yet' — preserves all three elements.
Ends with the explicit conditional: 'Decision needed: backport the cache-key fix into v4.8, or wait for v4.9? Recommendation: backport tomorrow, once the integration suite passes.'
All numbers (16:42, 16:47, 7, 312, 418, 6) trace directly to fixture; no unsupported estimates or invented figures.
Mechanism described as cached recommendation served to different customer causing checkout failure — same as fixture's 'shared cached recommendation entry'; no added failure modes or impacts.
Identifies process narration, arrow-chain notation, 'definitely', '✅ fixed and ready', and trailing summary as removed; frames cuts as style/process material, not as removing facts or caveats.
